attchmntText: AVT Natural Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AVT Natural Products Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 11.11.2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30.09.2026. The meeting commenced at 12.00 noon and concluded at 2.15 p.m. The Unaudited Financial results and the Limited Review report issued by M/s Suri & Co, Chartered Accountants, Statutory Auditors of the Company are enclosed with the announcement.
